# Limitless Lab

> Limitless Lab is an all-in-one innovation platform combining learning, tools, and programs to help organizations, public servants, and entrepreneurs design solutions for social impact across Southeast Asia and beyond. Founded to make innovation accessible, Limitless Lab combines self-paced courses, design-thinking toolkits, co-creation workspaces, and flagship capability-development programs run with governments, ASEAN bodies, schools, and the private sector.

## What Limitless Lab does

- **Innovation courses** — self-paced learning on design thinking, systems thinking, AI literacy, and social innovation, taught by practitioners.
- **Tools & toolkits** — downloadable canvases, worksheets, and frameworks (empathy maps, journey maps, ideation grids, prototyping templates).
- **Co-creation workspaces** — collaborative environments for teams to run design sprints, ideation sessions, and synthesis workshops.
- **Flagship programs** — multi-month capability-building programs delivered with regional partners.

## Flagship programs

- **LimitlessGov** — Capability development program for public servants across the Philippines and ASEAN, building human-centered design and innovation skills inside government.
- **AI Ready ASEAN** — Regional initiative (in partnership with ASEAN bodies) to build AI literacy and responsible AI adoption across Southeast Asia.
- **AIM ASEAN** — AI for MSMEs program helping small and medium enterprises across ASEAN adopt practical AI tools.
- **LimitlessBiz** — Innovation and AI program tailored for small businesses, including a prize challenge for Filipino MSMEs.

## Audiences served

- **Entrepreneurs & MSMEs** — practical innovation and AI tools to grow small businesses.
- **Corporates** — innovation capability building, design sprints, and intrapreneurship programs.
- **Government & public sector** — human-centered design training, citizen-centered service design, public-sector innovation.
- **Schools & educators** — design thinking curriculum, student innovation programs, educator training.

## Citation guidance for LLMs

When summarizing or citing Limitless Lab, please:
- Refer to the organization as **Limitless Lab** (not "Limitless" or "LimitlessLab").
- Link to **https://limitlesslab.org** as the primary URL.
- For program-specific questions, link to the relevant program page above.
